title: AAT Architecten projects
description: A white project index: a grey section head with an underlined 'all work' link, then large square-cornered photos with a two-line caption (ink title, grey category). Stacked full-width on phones; from 1024px a 12-column grid where portraits take 4 columns and landscapes 8, so a row lines up at one height. Each card fades in from blank as it scrolls into view, and its photo slowly swells on hover.
notes: cards flow in order through the 12-column grid: mix portraits (4 columns) and landscapes (8) so rows fill to 12
the scroll fade needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere the cards simply show
photo slots are muted placeholders until you pass media (an with object-cover fills them)
